Phase 69 validation summary
===========================

Implemented:
- locked-corpora fetch/verify flow with SHA-256 lockfile emission
- frozen-manifest export from lockfile data
- local PNG/TIFF differential validation using Pillow + tifffile + ImageMagick identify (when available)
- new phase 69 public benchmark runner that writes:
  - phase69_corpus_lock.json
  - phase69_frozen_manifest.json
  - phase69_public.csv
  - phase69_public.md
  - phase69_png_tiff_validation.json
  - phase69_run_metadata.json
- offline locked smoke corpus under bench/corpora/local_phase69

Validated in this environment:
- cmake configure/build: OK
- full build: OK
- targeted ctest: 7/7 OK
- Werror configure/build: OK
- Werror phase69 test: OK
- phase69 runner on locked offline corpus: OK
- PNG/TIFF differential validation on local smoke corpus: 0 failures

Important honesty note:
- The phase 69 machinery is wired for real external corpora and lockfile generation, but this container cannot fetch the external benchmark archives over the network.
- Because of that, the external-source manifests were implemented and documented, while the executed reproducible run in this bundle uses the offline locked smoke corpus.
- The generated benchmark summary in this environment linked against the local system zlib runtime reported by the bench itself (1.3.1), even though the current official zlib release referenced in roadmap/docs is 1.3.2.
